verdict.rationale: The GST portal's own help modules cover the core transactions: applying for registration (Part A/B), registering with DSC or Electronic Verification Code, filing returns, and generating a challan and making payment. Together these indicate registration, filing and payment are done through the portal. Missing for 10: the evidence is only help-page headings with no explicit statement that each flow is completed end-to-end online, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration of completing a registration, filing or payment.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
